name: core_db-build
description: Bundles core_db/src (with the pg driver) into core_db/dist/core_db.js, the file the manifest loads (DESIGN §56.2.1). It lives in build/ so the resource root has no package.json (FXServer's yarn builder).

scripts.build: esbuild ../src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --external:pg-native --banner:js="// fxlint-disable-file: generated by 'npm run build' (core_db/build) from src/ - edit the source, not this file." --outfile=../dist/core_db.js --log-level=warning
scripts.//test: Globs, not directories: node --test runs a positional directory as a module. Needs the test database (CORE_TEST_PG_URL, DESIGN §56.10.1).
